## What & why

One paragraph: what changes, and the problem it solves. Link issues (`Fixes #`).

## Evidence

- [ ] `make test`, `make typecheck`, `make lint` green (in-container)
- [ ] Behavioral proof: which command/endpoint/screenshot shows it works
- [ ] UI changes: before/after screenshots + `make`-driven browser QA if the
      harness covers the touched area
- [ ] New config/behavior: example yaml + README (+ zh-CN) + docs/ updated,
      CHANGELOG entry under "Unreleased"

## Notes for reviewer

Anything subtle, skipped alternatives, follow-up debt.
